# Redistribution permission record

The FK33 FJAR Miner maintainer, Ryan Mann, represents that David Stanfill,
publisher of the SQRL bridge and a Squirrels Research contributor, directly
granted him permission to redistribute the original bridge executable and this
two-site patched derivative as part of this project.

This file records the maintainer's representation so users and downstream
redistributors can understand why the executable is present. It is not a
general-purpose license grant by this repository, does not cover unrelated
SQRL materials, and does not replace the original correspondence. The
maintainer should retain that correspondence and provide it if provenance is
challenged.

Squirrels Research and SQRL are not endorsing this miner merely because the
bridge is redistributed here. Project-authored files remain under the
repository's MIT license; the bundled bridge is third-party software handled
under the permission described above.
